_comment: Live catalogue captured from nutrigreenz-project.vercel.app on 3 Aug 2026. Prices are per-SKU and GST-INCLUSIVE, matching how the storefront and src/lib/gst.ts treat them. Descriptions are the CATEGORY fallback text the PDP renders — no product in the catalogue carries its own description, which is the single biggest gap this sheet exists to close.

oils.name: Cold-pressed oils
oils.gstBasis: Edible vegetable oils are taxed at 5% (groundnut oil HSN 1508, coconut oil HSN 1513).

ghee.name: A2 Ghee
ghee.gstBasis: Ghee and butter fats fall under HSN 0405, taxed at 12%.

honey.name: Raw Honey
honey.gstBasis: Natural honey HSN 0409. Nil when unbranded and not in a unit container; 5% once branded and packaged, which is the case here.

products.name: Groundnut Cold-Pressed Oil
products.descriptionOnSite: Pressed slow and cold from a single farm lot, this oil keeps the flavour and nutrition that industrial refining strips away. You can taste the difference from the very first tempering.

products.name: A2 Gir Cow Ghee
products.descriptionOnSite: Made the traditional Bilona way — curd is hand-churned to butter, then slow-simmered to golden ghee the same day the milk is collected. Nothing about it is hurried.
